populationBasis: TÜİK ADNKS 2025, 31 December 2025; existing source observations preserved
method: Uniform national planning coefficients applied to measured district population. These are synthetic service-access scenarios, not measured 2025 district needs, costs, poverty or coverage.

limitations: Coverage, eligibility fractions, target choices and costs are illustrative assumptions selected to exercise the allocation model, not inferred official statistics.
No district-specific deprivation or service-quality ranking is claimed. Poverty adjustment uses separately labelled district profiles; null is unknown, not zero.
All districts share cost/fiscal factors of 1 until comparable local estimates are supplied.

Infrastructure quantities are resident-access equivalents because the current app requires person-based counts. This scenario does not calculate physical connections, m³, tonnes, grid engineering or facility counts.
One-year operating costs are included with capital costs. Later-year staffing/maintenance funding is not provided by this envelope.
povertyInput: District povertyProfiles, with explicit provenance. No poverty rate inferred from spending.
